description: Soleon local agent emulation — (1) every save under .soleon/agents/<slug>/ (SOUL.md, config.json, skills/, evals/) is pushed to the platform draft instantly via patch_agent_draft; a conflict stops the session and asks (exit 2); files anywhere else are ignored. (2) Each run of a pulled agent's subagent is recorded on the platform trace as ONE turn — the prompt, every tool call, the answer — via record_agent_turn (SubagentStart mints the turn id, SubagentStop reports the transcript); other subagents are untouched.
